environment.integration: Current workspace production TypeScript + real packaged native broker. No build, app launch or GUI test in this batch.

validation.composition: 3 capability/matrix U checks + 3 real native/service I checks + 5 existing tokenizer regressions; not 11 formal acceptance cases.
validation.initialHarnessFailure: 8 passed / 3 failed: finally block explicitly closed the capability already closed by FileBuffer.dispose(). Removed only this duplicate close; no product fix. Original report, observations and test source retained.

matrix.statIntegrity: All 354 independent readbacks preserved original bytes/SHA-256, inode, mtimeNs and ctimeNs; no save or checkpoint calls.
matrix.caseComparisonBoundary: Each U transformed-name row cites its originating registry key/language, not an independently emulated Codex resolver. Case transforms of P/p and R/r are observational and do not claim reference case resolution. Primary 345-row I counts use the original entry spelling.
matrix.grammarBoundary: Same ID does not establish same tokens/colors; different ID may be alias or a genuinely different grammar. The 266 plain fallbacks are a material highlighter coverage defect, not successful grammar support.
artifactOverrides: sample.potx: archive, despite a potx language registry hint
sample.wasm: binary by approved explicit routing override

scope: Pure UTF-8 synthetic samples; actual FileService/FileRootsService/FileRecoveryStore/FileBuffer + broker disk reads. API forwarding functions are spies over real production services, not mocks. No Electron IPC transport, real App or theme/pixel comparison claim.

requirementsReview.F05: R06.1 and 2026-10-17 user requirement require complete Codex highlighter parity; recorded differences cannot satisfy that stronger requirement. M9-DEV-038 remains open.
requirementsReview.F06: The original case explicitly allows a documented unsupported custom-mapping branch. No stronger requirement mandates configurable language overrides. Full/compound/final .ts names retain fixed TypeScript selection; attempted custom fields are rejected at strict route/open request schema. No override was installed.
requirementsReview.F28: The original row permits no-host fallback, which was observed, but R06.18/D05 additionally require production host/adapter engineering and prohibit indefinite disablement as delivery. Keep formal F28 pending until that stronger requirement is met; registration/longest suffix/preferred/explicit-null arbitration was not executed.
